title: A good kitchen scale with an 11-pound capacity; weighs in both kg and ounces/pounds; surface looks used however
text:
A good kitchen scale with an 11-pound capacity; weighs in both kg and ounces/pounds; surface looks used however. I own a [[ASIN:B00009K3SI Soehnle Triple Digital Food Scale]] that has an 11-pound capacity but can measure in grams which I purchased in October 2005 and it is still going strong 11 years later. Obviously for measuring very light items(like grams of tea) I needed to purchase [[ASIN:B002SC3LLS American Weigh Scales AWS 1KG Digital Pocket Scale, 1000 x 0.1g]] because it wouldn't register on this scale.

This KitchenAid also has an 11-pound (5 kg) capacity. It measures in kilograms (which is 1,000 larger than grams) and ounces/pounds. It won't measure tiny teaspoons of tea leaves but I find it to be almost as good as my Soehnle when I compared it side-by-side. The tare function works as well as my Soehnle also.

The scale measures 7-1/2 inches by 8-1/2 inches. It comes with one-year replacement warranty. The scale takes one 9V battery which IS NOT included. It turns on easily and the display is bright and incredibly easy to read.

There are two things I don't like. First, my unit arrived discolored. Apparently the plastic packaging it comes in "melts" onto the scale surface and leaves a clear zebra-looking border around the entire scale that makes it look worn and used. The second thing I don't like is that the scale turns on easily. This means if I lay something on the exact spot of the LED that powers it on and off, it will power on.

Other than this, this scale is competitively priced and appears to be as good as others on the market. Of course only time will tell if this will last. I will update my review if this scale fails.

product_metadata.title: KitchenAid FBA_ Gourmet Stainless Steel Electronic Scale, 11-Pound
features: Accurate, easy-to-use digital kitchen scale weighs up to 11 pounds (5 kilograms) in precise graduations of 0.05 ounce
An Easy-to-read, brightly-lit LCD display screen with simple touch-screen controls
Features a stainless steel platform that cleans easily; measuring directly on the platform, on a plate or in a bowl
The add and weight tare features allows for calculating the net weight of your ingredients; automatically subtracts the weight of any bowl or container
Run on (1) 9-volt battery (not included); limited lifetime warranty
description: The KitchenAid Gourmet Stainless Steel Electronic Scale is perfect for every home and lifestyle. The best companion for a health-conscious cook, this scale features precise sensor technology to ensure accuracy and immediate responses. It features a large, stainless steel weighing platform, to accommodate larger bowls and food items. Sophisticatedly designed, this KitchenAid Gourmet scale can also be used a postage machine for your mail or a scale for your children's science projects. The large, brightly-lit LCD displays feature touch-screen controls. This scale will display results in grams, ounces, pounds, kilograms and the Unit button lets you change the unit of measurement with ease. This kitchen scale can weighs up to 11 pounds (5050 grams) in graduations of 0.05 ounces (1 gram) to help you achieve your diet and weight goals. Featuring a convenient Tare button, which automatically subtracts the weight of any bowl or container to calculate the net weight of your ingredients.. The pleasing aesthetic design complements any kitchen décor and it cleans quickly and stores easily. Runs on one 9-volt battery (not included) and is guaranteed with lifetime limited warranty. Scale measures 8-1/2 x 7-1/2 x 1-1/4 inches.
